purpose: Reads and plans the Description of a Solution or Solution Constraint, which is one record per Keyword part: it parses Keyword lines and Assumptions, builds the tree, orders and moves parts, previews a paste, and plans the move or the removal of a whole level, with the host supplying every read.
namedChanges: The I/O seam. The three functions that talked to the app's query cache (`readLevel`, `planPartialWrite`, `removalPlan`) take `host: LevelHost` where they took `qc: QueryClient` (same position), and each call is replaced by the host method, in the same order, with the same awaits and loop structure:

`const origin = vaultOriginOf(planVault);` (removalPlan) is removed: `origin` fed only the replaced find, and the host works the origin out of `planVault`. `vaultOriginOf` is used nowhere else in the file.

The interface `LevelHost` is added and exported (its comments name the GilbApp call each method replaces). The imports of `@tanstack/react-query`, `./config`, `./planFind` and `./picture` are removed.
`vaultIdOfEntity` of `./picture` (4 lines) is copied as a non-exported function (`src/picture.ts` lines 73-76).
Comments in the three functions that named `fetchQuery` and `readCached` say what a fresh read needs of any cache.

library.title: Description parts model (Keyword parts)
library.note: Parsing, tree, ordering and removal plans; the editor on screen is description-parts-view.
